module_title: Exceptions (Viruses) and Carl Woese's Three-Domain System
introduction: Biology always has exceptions. Some entities do not fit into Whittaker's 5 Kingdoms at all. Furthermore, modern DNA analysis led to an even higher level of classification above the Kingdom: The Domain.

core_concepts.title: Viruses, Viroids, and Prions
core_concepts.description:
These found 'NO place' in the 5-Kingdom system because they are truly 'Acellular' (not cells). 
1. Virus: Made of genetic material (DNA or RNA) wrapped in a protein coat (Capsid). 
2. Viroids: Smaller than viruses, consist ONLY of free-floating RNA without any protein coat (causes potato spindle tuber disease). 
3. Prions: Abnormally folded infectious 'Proteins' that cause neurological diseases (e.g., Mad Cow Disease).

core_concepts.title: Carl Woese's Three-Domain System
core_concepts.description:
In 1990, Carl Woese separated organisms based on 16S rRNA sequence differences, creating a new taxonomic category above Kingdom called the **'Domain'**. 
He split Kingdom Monera into two, creating 3 Domains: 
1. Archaea (Ancient, extreme bacteria). 
2. Bacteria (True bacteria / Eubacteria). 
3. Eukarya (Contains Protista, Fungi, Plantae, and Animalia).

core_concepts.title: Archaebacteria (The Extremophiles)
core_concepts.description:
These are the oldest living fossils on Earth, capable of surviving the most extreme environments. 
1. Halophiles: Live in extreme salty areas. 
2. Thermoacidophiles: Live in hot sulfur springs. 
3. Methanogens: Live in marshy areas and the gut of ruminant animals (cows/buffaloes). They are responsible for producing biogas (Methane).

important_entities.name: Lichens
important_entities.key_fact: Symbiotic relationship between Fungi and Algae
important_entities.significance: A Lichen is not a single organism. It is a 'Symbiotic relationship' (mutual benefit) between an Algae (which prepares food via photosynthesis) and a Fungus (which provides shelter and absorbs water). Lichens also do not have a defined place in the 5-Kingdom classification.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: A normal living cell contains BOTH DNA and RNA. But a virus NEVER contains both at the same time. A virus will contain either strictly DNA or strictly RNA.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: A Viroid is just naked RNA. It lacks the protein coat (Capsid) that a standard virus has.

exam_strategy_tips: NDA/CDS Question: 'Which bacteria are responsible for the production of methane gas in marshy areas and the guts of cows?' Answer: Methanogens (a type of Archaebacteria).
